# Runbook Template

## Service

Name the service, component, or platform capability.

## Purpose

Describe what this runbook helps operate.

## Preconditions

List required access, tools, environment, and safety checks.

## Procedures

Describe normal operations, diagnostics, remediation, and rollback steps.

## Alerts

List relevant alerts and expected first response.

## Validation

Describe how to confirm recovery or successful operation.

## Escalation

List when and how to escalate.
